current_prompt.body:
PROVIDE a valid 4-coloring for the wheel graph W_11 (12 nodes: central hub node 0 connected to nodes 1-11, with nodes 1-11 forming a cycle) by assigning each node a color from {1,2,3,4} such that adjacent nodes have different colors.
DEMONSTRATE that a 3-coloring is impossible because the odd cycle (nodes 1-11) combined with the hub node forces a fourth color.
OUTPUT the coloring as a list of node‑color pairs.
EXPLAIN the impossibility proof without performing any actual coloring calculation.

VERIFY that the outer cycle (odd length) uses at least three colors
VERIFY that the hub node is colored differently from each of its adjacent outer nodes
